summary: Goldgroup Mining Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a Canadian material-change report) furnishing a Notice of Change of Auditor. At the Company's request, Davidson & Company LLP resigned effective September 10, 2026, and BDO USA, P.C. was appointed the same day, both approved by the Board. No reservations or reportable events exist for the two most recent fiscal years. This is a routine auditor transition, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or risk-arb angle apply.
